work.note: The existing primary bibliography and claim 027200-c02 date publication of the three volumes 1954–1955; this does not date the fictional history of Middle-earth.

description: Examines how the Ring tempts characters with promises of power, comparing Boromir, Galadriel, Sam, and others to test simple claims that Tolkien opposes power itself.
